blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Philippines — The Marawi-based Moro Consensus Group (MCG) has condemned the reported home demolitions, movement restrictions and military lockdown in Hebron and other Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank, calling on the international community to take action to protect civilians. In a statement, Drieza Lininding, MCG chairman, said the measures imposed on Palestinian communities constituted collective punishment and violated their basic rights, including freedom of movement, livelihood and access to shelter. “The struggle of the Palestinian people is a matter of universal human rights and justice.
